title: Director, Product Management
job_description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Director, Product Management will lead development of next‑generation IVR and conversational automation capabilities, including the modernization of our voice self‑service ecosystem. This role requires a leader with deep expertise in IVR platforms—particularly Google GECX/Playbooks and related Google Contact Center AI tooling—who can deliver generative and agentic IVR experiences that dramatically improve customer outcomes and operational performance.

You will own the full product lifecycle for our Centerwell IVR and voice automation portfolio, from strategic roadmap creation to production delivery and continuous improvement. This leader must pair strong technical fluency in modern IVR architectures with a proven track record of delivering measurable value through intelligent automation, LLM‑powered dialog flows, and multimodal conversational experiences.

IVR & Conversational AI Leadership

Lead the vision, strategy, and execution for our enterprise IVR ecosystem, with a deep focus on modernization, automation, and scalable platform design

Own roadmap creation and delivery for IVR capabilities using Google GECX including voice bots, routing logic, LLM/NLU/NLP models, call intent prediction, and virtual‑agent experiences

Drive adoption of generative and agentic IVR capabilities, enabling dynamic dialog generation, autonomous task handling, and context‑aware workflow orchestration

Product Strategy & Delivery

Translate business priorities and customer pain points into actionable technical product strategies for IVR and conversational automation

Build and lead high‑performing product teams; hire and develop talent with strong IVR, NLU, and conversational AI expertise

Validate product effectiveness through measurable KPIs such as intent capture/accuracy, authentication, containment, deflection, CSAT/NPS, and call‑efficiency improvements

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

Partner with engineering, operations, contact center, analytics, CX, and UX teams to deliver best‑in‑class IVR solutions

Serve as the primary business representative for all IVR‑related initiatives, ensuring strong alignment across the enterprise

Drive governance, consistency, and standards across IVR platforms, ensuring clean architecture, reusable components, and scalable design patterns

Operational Excellence

Support delivery teams through active leadership, removing blockers and ensuring initiatives meet quality and cost expectations

Conduct solution‑wide evaluations to identify improvements across architecture, LLM/NLU models, routing, and system integrations

Manage risks, dependencies, and cross‑team prioritization for all IVR and conversational AI initiatives


Use your skills to make an impact


Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree

8+ years of product management or technology leadership experience with at least 5+ years focused on IVR and voice automation

Deep hands‑on experience with IVR platforms such as Google, Genesys, etc.

Proven delivery of generative‑AI‑powered and agentic IVR conversational experiences

Strong understanding of IVR self-service, digital deflection, call routing, telephony, SIP, APIs, and backend system integration

Experience delivering multi‑year product roadmaps with agile and human‑centered design practices

Strong leadership skills and ability to manage, coach, and grow high‑performing teams

Excellent communication skills with executive presence and demonstrated ability to present and influence C-Suite Leadership

Demonstrated success with OKR‑driven product delivery

Experience managing large enterprise‑scale, cross‑functional initiatives


Preferred Qualifications

MBA or Master’s Degree

Healthcare (Primary Care, Pharmacy, etc.) experience

Experience modernizing legacy IVR into cloud‑native conversational voice platforms, specifically Google GECX/Playbooks

Direct experience leading teams building conversational AI (voice + chat)

Strong familiarity with cloud contact center platforms such as Genesys, Nuance, Amazon Connect, Five9, etc.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.


Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.


Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.


$168,000 - $231,000 per year


This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

Application Deadline: 09-15-2026

About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it.
